column3: Machine output preserves UTF-8 bytes; terminal text replaces unencodable characters; BootUI writes through UTF-8 PrintWriter.
Python package and console-script entry points replace BootUI's JVM main entry.
a catalog-listed tool returning 404 keeps its server message; an unlisted tool gets a static hint from local CLI metadata without a /panels request.

Server JSON bytes remain verbatim except at token occurrences: string contents and object keys are replaced in place, and a matching number literal becomes the string "[redacted]". Terminal-rendered payloads and CLI-generated messages are redacted before output; invalid JSON receives plain-text redaction. Token-redacted JSON preserves every nonmatching source byte.
Root-level --fail-on remains hidden for leading-option placement and is validated by the selected tool's FailOn parser.
When a bundled tool is unlisted, the CLI emits a static version hint without a /panels request; its manifest lacks BootUI stack metadata.
